## What was added to the system region

```
SEMANTIC RULES THE ANSWER IS AUDITED AGAINST.
These rules are stated as propositions about what the answer may assert. A deterministic
gate checks the answer against the supplied statements after it is written; an answer
that breaks a rule is refused, never repaired, and nothing rewrites it to pass.
SOURCE NAMES ARE PROVENANCE, NEVER EVIDENCE.
  A supplied statement carries two different things: what a source reported, and the name of the
  source or dataset it came from. The names that occur in the supplied statements are listed in
  the trusted context under SOURCE NAMES.
  A publisher name, source name, registry display name, dataset title, provider label or
  provenance label identifies where data came from.
  It may support a statement about provenance itself, naming the source by its whole label.
  It never supports:
    - a domain proposition, through any word inside a label
    - a number, through any figure inside a label
    - a forbidden concept, through any phrase inside a label
  So a word that occurs in the supplied statements only inside a name has not been supplied, and
  neither has a figure inside one.
  Naming a source by its whole name, to say where a statement came from, is always allowed.
OBSERVED STATEMENTS ARE ATOMIC AND DIRECTLY SUPPORTED.
  An item of statement_classifications classified OBSERVED_OR_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED states exactly
  one proposition, and a source content statement, or a fact the task states about the packet,
  states that proposition itself. Sharing words with a supplied statement is not support.
  Such an item never joins alternatives with "or" or "either ... or": one classification cannot
  say which alternative the evidence establishes. Write each alternative the statements do
  establish as its own item, or classify the joined statement HYPOTHESIS_TO_VALIDATE or
  UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE. This concerns items classified OBSERVED_OR_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED only:
  alternatives such an item denies together, and every other field, may use the word in its
  ordinary sense.
  Where support is incomplete, the item is HYPOTHESIS_TO_VALIDATE or UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE,
  never OBSERVED_OR_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED.
WHAT EACH FIELD'S TEXT DOES.
  target_actor_if_supported, observed_need, candidate_intervention_class,
  evidence_bound_reasoning_summary, commercial_claims_supported
    asserted as supported: every clause is a claim about the packet, and every word describing
    the domain comes from what a source reported, never from a source name or from prior
    knowledge
  hypothesis_statement
    a hypothesis to test, read clause by clause: each clause is framed as something to test, and
    every word describing the domain still comes from what a source reported
  independence_status, reliability_status
    restates a fact the task gives about the packet, in the task's own terms
  critical_uncertainties
    each item states something that is not known, as an open question or as a statement that it
    is not established, and never asserts it
  commercial_claims_not_supported
    each item names a claim this packet does not support, and never says that the claim is
    established or supported
  recommended_next_evidence
    each item names the evidence or observation that would have to be obtained, and states no
    finding
  statement_classifications
    each item takes the meaning of the classification it carries: OBSERVED_OR_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED
    asserts what a source content statement establishes; HYPOTHESIS_TO_VALIDATE proposes
    something to test; UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE states something that is not established
CONCEPTS THIS PACKET NEVER ESTABLISHES, beside the transformations above. Naming one
as unknown, as not supported, or as something to observe is allowed; asserting it is
refused.
  MARKET_SIZE
    it is NOT: the size of any market, which no observation here measures
  BUYER_NEED
    it is NOT: a need that any buyer has
  UNMET_NEED
    it is NOT: an unmet or underserved need
  SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION
    it is NOT: dissatisfaction with any existing solution
  SOLUTION_GAP
    it is NOT: a gap no solution fills
  COMPETITIVE_GAP
    it is NOT: a weakness in whoever already serves the need
  PROFITABILITY
    it is NOT: profit for anybody
A FORM_HYPOTHESIS ANSWER ALSO SATISFIES EACH OF THESE.
  - recommended_next_evidence has at least one item
  - statement_classifications has at least one item
  - at least one item of statement_classifications is HYPOTHESIS_TO_VALIDATE or
    UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE: a packet this narrow always leaves something to test or something
    unknown
  - subject is the SUBJECT the task names, copied exactly
  - supporting_evidence_ids cites at least one Evidence id
  - supporting_claim_ids cites at least one Claim id
  - every Evidence id in supporting_evidence_ids has the Claim id it is labelled with in
    supporting_claim_ids
  - no dimension appears both in supported_dimensions and in unsupported_dimensions
  - a hypothesis, an unknown and a request for evidence stay what they are: no adverb of
    certainty and no wording of confirmation turns one into a conclusion
```
